dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Presence of a single, thick, high-contrast white horizontal band across the greater coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence and sharp boundary of pale bluish-gray edges along the folded primary and secondary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Small, irregular pale yellowish-white patch on the posterior neck/nape region.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Distinct and sharp color transition between the black crown and the greenish-gray mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent, large, high-contrast white auricular/cheek patch completely bordered by black plumage.
